Wastewater is directed into two sets of secondary aerated ponds, operated in parallel. Each pond includes total digester volume of 110,000 gallons and an aerated treatment volume of 1,190,000 gallons.
Flow is mixed following primary and secondary treatment for final polishing in three maturation ponds in series.
The system includes one effluent and wet-weather storage pond that provides approximately 21 million gallons of operational storage prior to wastewater disposal.
Treated effluent is disposed of at the Selby Percolation Site (Figure 2), which consists of seven percolation ponds with a combined surface area of approximately 4.4 acres.
As an alternative disposal option, the facility maintains a 25-acre sprayfield (Figure 3) for use when discharge to the percolation ponds is not feasible and onsite storage is limited.
